### The Gestational Age Is Recorded in a Format the Registration Form Does Not Accept {#sec-problem-details-34}

The patient record holds the gestational age at birth as completed weeks and days, in the format the registration form gives as its example: two digits for the completed weeks, from 20 to 49, a plus sign, and one digit for the additional days, from 0 to 6, as in 25+4 for 25 weeks and 4 days.
The platform calculates the total gestation days, on which eligibility for the Core Module and the analyses by gestational age rest, from a gestational age in this format only.
The registration form therefore refuses any other format; a gestational age in another format reaches the platform only around that form, such as through an import or from before the check existed.
This message appears in the validation report when a patient record holds a gestational age in another format, for example with a space in it, without the plus sign, with a single digit for the weeks, or with more than six days.

Please open the patient record's dashboard (see @sec-solution-1) and edit its profile (see @sec-solution-17): enter the gestational age in the format described above; the platform then calculates the total gestation days from it.
